997-3240-6277-6462.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1556-2645-5963-6871-7115.description:
Cast Staff of Domination by paying {3}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Scorched Ruins.
Cast Marvin by paying {2}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Staff of Domination.
At the beginning of your end step, Toph, the First Metalbender triggers, earthbending Marvin, thus giving it haste.
Activate Marvin using Scorched Ruins's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Marvin using Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Marvin.
Repeat from step 6.

3478-5413-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability
Repeat.

549-2685-4017-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-2685-4017-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-5734.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
3259-5434-5734.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

2793-3743-4772-5089-7435.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4772-5089-7435.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-2806-7110.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent
1618-2440-2806-7110.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Reality Strobe.
Reality Strobe triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Stormchaser's Talent triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Reality Strobe.
Repeat.
1618-2440-2806-7110.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Stormchaser's Talent. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

586-2921-5258-5618-7183.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

997-2173-4336-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1921-2034-4404.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Corridor Monitor from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Corridor Monitor token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Corridor Monitor token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Corridor Monitor token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Corridor Monitor token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1912-2043-4715-6753.description:
Activate Urza by paying {4}, creating two token copies of Prized Statue that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
When the Prized Statue tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

7-2292-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
7-2292-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-2292-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
7-2292-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

678-2292-4826-6644.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1486-3457-5929.notablePrerequisites:
Seeker of Skybreak does not have summoning sickness.
Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-3457-5929.description:
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Seeker of Skybreak ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

3487-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Aetherstorm Roc trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2099-2558-5687-5689.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Raiders' Spoils, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1115-4053-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
1115-4053-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

579-3995-4289.notablePrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab does not have summoning sickness.
579-3995-4289.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1737-4659-4853.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature card with mana value 2 or less exiled by Prototype Portal.
1737-4659-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying at most {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the imprinted card.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

500-2493-4923.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
500-2493-4923.description:
Cast Cabal Ritual by paying {1}{B}, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Archaeomancer and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Archaeomancer tokens enter, they each trigger, returning Cabal Ritual and Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

575-4050-4121.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Birchlore Rangers, adding one mana of any color.
Birchlore Rangers dies, triggering Yedora, returning Birchlore Rangers to the battlefield face down as a Forest land with no other types or abilities.
Activate Birchlore Rangers by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Birchlore Rangers's morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1000-2493-2727-4872.notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Mystic Reflection was foretold.
1000-2493-2727-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Archaeomancer.
Cast From Under the Floorboards by paying {3}{B}{B}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer and gaining 3 life.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Time Warp, and From Under the Floorboards to your hand.
Repeat.

730-765-1479.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
730-765-1479.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Emeria Angel, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Emeria Angel trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
